description: fnpf_3d_coral_array (three FNPF point absorbers driven by REEF3D::CORAL, a refined zone around each) with a checkpoint every 5 steps (P 48 5, the newest three kept): the uninterrupted run of fnpf_3d_coral_array_restart. Every body solves its unit modes from its own last solution (fnpf_6DOF_grid::psib, in the checkpoint as fb_psi_<body>_<mode>).
covers: fnpf_6DOF: the unit modes of every body (psib) on level 0 and the patches, grid_fields
